capabilities.description: Delegate one local goal to a task runtime that admits supported work under its deployment profile.

attributes.name: task-profile
attributes.description: Deployment profile of the receiving local task runtime.

capabilities.description: Capture an immutable reported origin from a readonly local observation; grants no motion or localization verification.

operations.description: Submit the intact objective to a local task runtime and track its attributed result.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Exact deployed task profile admitted by the receiving runtime.

operations.description: Freeze one original Task observation as origin Memory. Explicit global scope offers this one record to the Node publisher. It does not load maps or call Pilot.

parameters.name: memory_id
parameters.description: A new immutable origin identity; repetitions cannot overwrite it.

parameters.name: expected_map_id
parameters.description: Exact expected local Mapping map label, not a verified shared frame or map revision.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Explicit global for shared experiment publication, or local for nonpublished local retention.
